summary: All 5 acceptance-matrix criteria requiring API coverage were verified with new pytest files (9 tests, all passing) and all 6 UI-facing criteria were verified with 6 named, re-runnable browser checks (all passing), including one run against the public preview URL. No bugs found.

checks.criterion: BUG FIX (primary): GET /api/download/website-package returns a valid, non-corrupt ZIP with exactly 5 members
checks.name: test_tscheck_download_website_package.py::test_download_website_package_returns_valid_zip
checks.evidence: GET /api/download/website-package -> 200, content-type application/zip, content-disposition attachment; filename=sps-medcare-website-package.zip, body 20210 bytes, zipfile.testzip()=None, namelist == {README.txt, sps-medcare-wordpress-import.xml, treatments.csv, sitemap.xml, robots.txt}

checks.criterion: GET /api/download/wordpress-xml returns the WordPress WXR import file
checks.name: test_tscheck_download_wordpress_xml.py::test_download_wordpress_xml_returns_wxr
checks.evidence: GET /api/download/wordpress-xml -> 200, content-type application/xml, content-disposition attachment; filename=sps-medcare-wordpress-import.xml, body 130759 bytes, parsed root tag 'rss', 36 <item> elements found

checks.criterion: GET /api/download/treatments-csv returns the treatment price list
checks.name: test_tscheck_download_treatments_csv.py::test_download_treatments_csv_returns_price_list
checks.evidence: GET /api/download/treatments-csv -> 200, content-type text/csv, content-disposition attachment; filename=sps-medcare-treatments.csv, header=['Treatment','Specialty','Cost in India (USD)', ...], 10 data rows

checks.criterion: No regression in the core patient journey after the backend router change
checks.name: test_tscheck_core_journey_regression.py (6 tests)
checks.evidence: GET /api/specialties -> 200 (10 items); GET /api/treatments -> 200 (10 items); GET /api/treatments/cardiac-treatment-in-india -> 200 savings_percent=88; GET /api/treatments/no-such-treatment -> 404; POST /api/inquiries {name,phone,country} -> 201 echoing country=India; POST /api/inquiries {name only} -> 422

checks.criterion: Downloads reachable from header nav in one click, routes to /export-data
checks.name: nav-download-reaches-export-data
checks.evidence: Clicked getByTestId('nav-download') from '/' -> URL became /export-data, getByTestId('download-package-card') visible

checks.criterion: Home page download strip button navigates to /export-data
checks.name: home-download-strip-navigates
checks.evidence: getByTestId('download-strip') visible on '/', clicked getByTestId('download-strip-button') -> URL became /export-data, download-package-card visible

checks.criterion: /export-data download buttons trigger real browser downloads with correct filenames; hrefs point at /api/download/* (no static file regression)
checks.name: export-data-downloads-trigger-real-files
checks.evidence: href(download-package-button)=/api/download/website-package, href(export-download-button)=/api/download/wordpress-xml; clicking the three buttons produced Playwright download events with suggestedFilename sps-medcare-website-package.zip, sps-medcare-wordpress-import.xml, sps-medcare-treatments.csv respectively; no response >=400 observed

checks.criterion: Same download flow verified through the public ingress URL (APP_URL)
checks.name: export-data-downloads-public-url
checks.evidence: Ran against https://health-deploy-6.preview.emergentagent.com/export-data: href=/api/download/website-package, click produced download event with suggestedFilename sps-medcare-website-package.zip

checks.criterion: Contact form UI flow: fill name/phone/country, submit -> success toast, name field clears
checks.name: contact-form-submits-successfully
checks.evidence: Filled contact-form-name/contact-form-phone, selected first option in contact-form-country, clicked contact-form-submit-button -> [data-sonner-toast] became visible and contact-form-name value reset to ''

action_items: note: spec_deviations confirm the legacy static files /sps-medcare-website-package.zip and /sps-medcare-wordpress-import.xml still exist in this dev pod's frontend/public and will 200 here; this was NOT treated as evidence of the fix per briefing instructions -- only /api/download/* endpoints and button hrefs were used as evidence.
